latest_release.name: v1.2.1
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* test(generic): support pandas 3.1 timedelta expectations by @JohnDReynolds in https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt/pull/895
* fix(indicators): select unmapped input columns by @JohnDReynolds in https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt/pull/889
* fix(data): initialize download kwargs in from_data by @JohnDReynolds in https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt/pull/890
* fix(utils): preserve dictionary state on rejected loads by @JohnDReynolds in https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt/pull/891
* fix(records): pass group_by to top_n and bottom_n masks by @wavebyrd in https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt/pull/892
* Fix single-column DataFrame outputs from pandas-ta by @Don-Yin in https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt/pull/893
* fix(data): preserve named Series in column alignment by @JohnDReynolds in https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt/pull/898
* fix(generic): prevent narrow integer diff overflow by @JohnDReynolds in https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt/pull/899
* fix(returns): return NaN or signed infinity for zero-volatility Sharpe and Sortino by @ryanduguid in https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt/pull/897
* perf(generic): O(n) rolling min/max using a monotonic deque by @destinyN1 in https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt/pull/901
* fix(indicators): avoid unsigned true range underflow by @JohnDReynolds in https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt/pull/900
* test(utils): keep invalid timezone fixture compatible with dateparser by @JohnDReynolds in https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt/pull/907
* fix(base): align reordered equal-length indexes by @JohnDReynolds in https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt/pull/905
* fix(generic): handle nonpositive diff periods by @JohnDReynolds in https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt/pull/906
* fix(portfolio): stop dropping a lot when flooring to size_granularity by @stooq1 in https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt/pull/894
* feat(generic): add crossed_below_1d_nb and crossed_below_nb by @20163070 in https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt/pull/908
* fix(records): respect group_by in MappedArray.describe on pandas 3 by @wavebyrd in https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt/pull/910
* Expose type hints by @Dreamsorcerer in https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt/pull/844
* fix(portfolio): divide gross exposure by portfolio value by @stooq1 in https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt/pull/903
* fix(returns): treat constant returns as zero volatility in Sharpe ratio by @gautamggg53 in https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt/pull/904
* Improve index-alignment and true-range performance while preserving validation and integer precision by @polakowo
* Consolidate regression tests and include shared test helpers in source distributions by @polakowo
* Expand documentation walkthroughs, add interactive charts, and refresh README examples and visuals by @polakowo

## New Contributors
* @Don-Yin made their first contribution in https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt/pull/893
* @ryanduguid made their first contribution in https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt/pull/897
* @destinyN1 made their first contribution in https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt/pull/901
* @stooq1 made their first contribution in https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt/pull/894
* @20163070 made their first contribution in https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt/pull/908
* @Dreamsorcerer made their first contribution in https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt/pull/844
* @gautamggg53 made their first contribution in https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt/pull/904

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/polakowo/vectorbt/compare/v1.2.0...v1.2.1
